base_note: Una pagina su come lavoriamo e su cosa potremmo fare per Partner in Pet Food (PPF).

evidence.claim: Partner in Pet Food produce alimenti per animali in 12 stabilimenti in Europa e serve oltre 400 clienti in 35 paesi.
evidence.quote: With 12 state-of-the-art factories across Europe, we serve more than 400 customers in 35 countries. || PPF has its headquarters in Budapest, Hungary and operates in 10 countries - France, The Netherlands , Germany, Sweden, Italy, Czech Republic, Slovakia, Poland, Hungary and Romania. || We distribute our products to more than 400 customers across 35 countries, including supermarkets, specialist pet shops, and veterinarians.
